title: Z3 Integration
concept: How XIOM integrates Z3 for static contract verification — translating XIOM contracts into SMT formulas and proving or disproving them.
why: Runtime contracts catch bugs in execution. Z3 proves they can NEVER happen — static verification is the highest level of correctness assurance.
syntax_ref:
# Run verification:
xiom verify src/

# With Z3 options:
xiom verify --timeout 30 --solver z3 src/

# Verification result:
# ✓ PROVED / ✗ COUNTEREXAMPLE / ? UNKNOWN
tips: Z3 works best on pure functions with integer/boolean logic — keep verification targets focused
A PROVED result is a mathematical guarantee — stronger than any amount of testing
Provide loop invariants for functions Z3 can't prove automatically
Verification covers ALL inputs satisfying requires — it's exhaustive, unlike testing
common_mistakes: Expecting Z3 to prove everything — it has limits, especially with complex data structures
Not providing enough constraints — Z3 needs complete specifications to prove anything
Using Z3-unsupported features (I/O, allocation) in verified functions
